settings.subtitle: Sleep
settings.title: Melatonin
settings.text: Melatonin is a naturally-occurring hormone released by the body's pineal gland, and is associated with the control of the sleep-wake cycle. It cues your brain to time of day, increasing when it's dark and decreasing when it's light.
